verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official hosted MCP server at mcp.supabase.com/mcp, and a local one via the CLI at localhost:54321/mcp. The docs cover tool groups, per-connection configuration (read_only, project_ref, features), agent guardrails, per-agent setup, and a plugin that bundles the server for one-command install. Hands-on probes confirm the endpoint is live and OAuth-gated with published granular scopes, and community threads show it in real use. missing for 10: the server is still labeled "Beta" and PAT-based CI access currently requires all scopes; no authenticated end-to-end tool-call was verified hands-on.
